tools.name: fetch-public-job-pages
tools.description: 批量抓取用户给出的有限官方 URL，返回每页可追溯正文或明确失败原因。每个成功页面带 quality=jd_complete/list_only/js_shell/empty；只有 jd_complete 才可直接进入 JD 提取与匹配，list_only 会优先展开详情页，js_shell/empty 不得冒充 JD 成功。JS 卡片列表页会自动展开：列表页本身 + 前 5 个详情页正文一并返回。failures 列表中的失败仅针对列出的 URL 本身；同批其余 URL 仍应继续逐一尝试。

input_model.description: A finite Agent-selected set of official public pages to capture at once.
input_model.title: FetchPublicJobPagesInput

PublicJobPageFetchFailure.description: One transparent per-page failure; successful evidence remains usable.
PublicJobPageFetchFailure.title: PublicJobPageFetchFailure

output_model.description: All successfully captured pages plus explicit failures from one bounded batch.
output_model.title: FetchPublicJobPagesOutput

tools.name: search-public-job-pages
tools.description: 搜索公开招聘页；仅在用户没有提供候选 URL（或全部候选 URL 均已抓取失败：fetch 错误或 dead_link 死链）、且 smartsheet 无匹配记录时用于发现直接招聘链接；部分候选失败绝不授权搜索。

input_model.description: A bounded public-web query selected by the Executor from the user's goal.
input_model.title: SearchPublicJobPagesInput

PublicCommunityScanRecord.description: One timestamped record inspected during an official community scan.
PublicCommunityScanRecord.title: PublicCommunityScanRecord

PublicJobSearchResult.description: One direct public career link observed in a fixed search-provider response.
PublicJobSearchResult.title: PublicJobSearchResult

output_model.description: Search evidence that lets the Executor choose a public page to inspect next.
output_model.title: SearchPublicJobPagesOutput

tools.name: query-career-sheet-records
tools.description: 查询招聘 smartsheet（内推/招聘链接台账）按企业/岗位/地点关键词与近 N 天过滤，返回候选招聘 URL；每条记录带 prior_metadata（公司/投递链接/内推码/更新时间）补足页面缺失字段；主证据源，无匹配记录时才用网络搜索；当 smartsheet 接口不可用或受限（error sheet_rate_limited / sheet_call_failed，如每日访问配额 400007 用尽）时，search-public-job-pages 是授权的备用数据源，应切换到公开搜索。

CareerSheetPriorMetadata.description:
Smartsheet-carried facts that can fill fields a page lacks.

Field mapping mirrors smartsheet-sources.md: 企业名称 -> company_name,
内推/招聘/投递链接 -> apply_url, 内推码(区分大小写) -> referral_code,
更新时间/更新日期 -> update_time.
CareerSheetPriorMetadata.title: CareerSheetPriorMetadata

input_model.description: One public HTTP(S) URL selected autonomously by Executor.

tools.name: fetch-wechat-article
tools.description: OCR 抓取微信公众号图文（含 ReadGZH 镜像）为可提取文本与候选。微信图文正文是图片，普通页面抓取返回空内容——目标为 mp.weixin.qq.com 链接时使用本工具（fetch-public-job-pages 也已自动路由微信链接）；门控关闭时返回 needs_manual_review（reason ocr_disabled）。注意：单个微信链接失败（如镜像返回验证墙/付费墙、文章无正文）只代表该链接本身不可用，不代表其他微信文章链接也会失败——每篇独立尝试，其余链接仍应继续抓取。

input_model.description: One public WeChat article URL (mp.weixin.qq.com or a ReadGZH mirror).
input_model.title: FetchWechatArticleInput

ExtractedJobDetails.description: A normalized job DTO whose values remain traceable to one page artifact.
ExtractedJobDetails.title: ExtractedJobDetails

output_model.description:
OCR slice outcome; a usable text carries the standard page evidence.

The page-evidence keys (artifact_id / source_url / content_hash /
visible_text) mirror the fetch contract so a slice that produced text
enters the observed-evidence pool through ``_with_observed_page``;
slices without text carry None/"" and are never persisted as evidence.
output_model.title: FetchWechatArticleOutput
